description_en: Queries the traffic information of a secondary ENI within a specified time period
description_zh: 调用DescribeEniMonitorData查询一块辅助网卡在指定时间段内使用的流量信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-eni-monitor-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id i-bp1a5zr3u7nq9cx0000 --start-time 2018-05-21T12:19:00Z --end-time 2018-05-21T12:22:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeEniMonitorData

parameters.help_en: The ID of the secondary ENI. By default, all secondary ENIs that are attached to the specified instance are queried
parameters.help_zh: 辅助网卡的ID。默认查询指定实例上所有已绑定的辅助网卡
parameters.name: eni_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to which the secondary ENI is attached
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. If the value of seconds (ss) is not 00, the time is automatically rounded up to the next minute
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据的起始时间点。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。如果指定的秒（ss）不是00，则自动换算为下一分钟。
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. If the value of seconds (ss) is not 00, the time is automatically rounded up to the next minute
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据的结束时间点。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。如果指定的秒（ss）不是00，则自动换算为下一分钟。
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The interval at which to retrieve monitoring data. Unit: seconds. Valid values:
60.
600.
3600.

Default value: 60
parameters.help_zh:
获取监控数据的间隔时间，单位：秒。取值范围：
60。
600。
3600。

默认值：60
parameters.name: period

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of returned entries
